decision: The competitor (Haas F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
event_name: Time 17:29 2018 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 28 June - 01 July 2018 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 13) and heard from the team representative, have considered the following matter and hereby determine the following
fact: Car 20 was released from a pit stop in an unsafe condition.
offence: Breach of Article 28.13 (b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video and audio of the pit stop of Car 20 at 16:25 and heard from the team representative. The team admitted that there had been a problem, with the accidental triggering of the blue ("ok") light on the wheel gun, falsely signaling that the wheel had been correctly fitted. The Stewards determined that the car was released in an unsafe condition in breach of Art. 28.13(b) as the wheel was not properly attached to the car when released. The team reacted instantly, instructing the driver to stop the car and the driver stopped the car in a safe manner immediately. Consistent with previous decisions of a similar nature, the Stewards decided that the grid place penalty mentioned in the above Article would not be applied as the driver took all appropriate actions at the first available opportunity. Accordingly, the Stewards fined the team €5,000. All
title: Doc 16 2018 Austrian Grand Prix Offence Haas Car 20 Release In An Unsafe Condition
to: The Team Manager, Haas F1 Team
